set.name: Gizmos & Gadgets
set.theme: Piltover and Zaun (Arcane): Academy, Chemtech, Clockwork, Cuddly, Enforcer, Glutton, Imperial, Mercenary, Mutant, Scrap, Sister, Socialite, Syndicate, Yordle.

notes.itemScope: Item and augment membership comes from the "TFTSet6" item/augment lists in the patch 13.11 CDragon file. Values come from the patch 11.24 file when the item exists there, else from 13.11. The list is the full pool the game data allows for the set mode, so it includes items obtainable only through augments, anvils or special rounds. Augments for this set were taken from every TFT6_Augment_* entry in the patch 11.24 file (the 13.11 list for this mode is empty); some may have been disabled or added later in the set.
notes.abilityValues: Computed with 100 AP and no items; star order 1/2/3. Unresolved placeholders listed per ability.
notes.augmentTiers: Inferred from icon art suffix or apiName; approximate.

mechanics: Hextech Augments introduced: pick one of three augments at 1-4, 3-3 and 4-5 (moved to 2-1, 3-2, 4-2 in Set 7). Three tiers (Silver, Gold, Prismatic); all players see the same tier at the same time. Augments appear on the Hexcore, visible to everyone. [11.22 notes]
Double Up (2v2 co-op mode) followed in 11.23. [11.22 notes]
Socialite trait marks hexes on the board that buff the unit standing on them. Mercenary uses a dice-based loot system. [CDragon trait text, 11.22 notes]
Wiki notes a level 11 shop odds row exists only in Set 6 through Level Up / High End Shopping augments: 1/2/12/50/35. [wiki Champion]
systemChanges: Item reworks for the set: Archangel's Staff (+25 AP every 4 s), Banshee's Claw (row shield blocking first ability up to 600), Bramble Vest grants 80 armor, Deathblade flat 50/75/100 AD by star, Quicksilver adds 20% AS, Runaan's +10 AD and no on-hit. [11.22 notes]
Neeko's Help drop rate from blue and gold orbs reduced slightly. [11.22 notes]
Hyper Roll became a permanent mode; starting gold 8 to 2; total gold 85 to 107. [11.22 notes]

augments.name: Academy Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Academic.

augments.name: Arcanist Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Arcanist. Gain a Twisted Fate.

augments.name: Ardent Censer
augments.description: Allies healed or shielded by Enchanters gain 40% stacking Attack Speed for the rest of combat (maximum once every 4 seconds).

augments.name: Ascension
augments.description: After 15 seconds of combat, your units deal 65% more damage.

augments.name: Assassin Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Assassin. Gain a Talon.

augments.name: Bodyguard Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Bodyguard. Gain a Leona.

augments.name: Bruiser Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Bruiser. Gain a Trundle.

augments.name: Built Different I
augments.description: Your units with no Traits active gain 300 Health and 50% Attack Speed.

augments.name: Calculated Loss
augments.description: After losing your combat, gain 2 gold and a free Shop refresh.

augments.name: Celestial Blessing I
augments.description: Your units heal for 12% of the damage dealt by attacks and Abilities. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to 300 Health.

augments.name: Challenger Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Challenger. Gain a Warwick.

augments.name: Chemical Overload I
augments.description: Chemtechs explode on death, dealing 20% of their max Health as magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes.

augments.name: Chemtech Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Chemtech. Gain a Zac.

augments.name: Clockwork Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Clockwork. Gain a Zilean.

augments.name: Cutthroat
augments.description: Assassins Mana Reave the first unit they attack, increasing their maximum Mana by 65% until they cast.

augments.name: Cybernetic Implants I
augments.description: Your champions holding an item gain 200 Health and 10 Attack Damage.

augments.name: Dominance
augments.description: After winning your player combat, gain 1 bonus gold for every 2 surviving units.

augments.name: Dual Rule
augments.description: There are now 2 Imperial Tyrants.

augments.name: Duet
augments.description: Summon 1 additional Socialite spotlight. Spotlighted units gain 500 Health.

augments.name: En Garde
augments.description: The first time an enemy is attacked by a Challenger, they are Disarmed for 3 seconds.

augments.name: Enchanter Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Enchanter. Gain a Taric.

augments.name: Enforcer Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Enforcer. Gain a Vi.

augments.name: Exiles
augments.description: Your units that start combat with no adjacent allies gain a 35% maximum Health shield for 8 seconds.

augments.name: Featherweights I
augments.description: Your 1 and 2 cost champions gain 30% Attack Speed and movement speed.

augments.name: First Aid Kit
augments.description: All healing and shielding on your units is increased by 35%.

augments.name: Hyper Roll
augments.description: If you have less than 10 gold at the end of a round, gain 2 gold.

augments.name: Imperial Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Imperial. Gain a Swain.

augments.name: Innovator Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Innovator.

augments.name: Item Grab Bag I
augments.description: Gain 1 random completed item(s).

augments.name: Knife's Edge I
augments.description: Your units that start combat in the front 2 rows gain 25 Attack Damage.

augments.name: Lifelong Learning
augments.description: Scholars that survive your combat permanently gain 5 Ability Power.

augments.name: Makeshift Armor I
augments.description: Your units with no items gain 30 Armor and Magic Resist.

augments.name: Mercenary Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Mercenary.

augments.name: Mutant Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Mutant. Gain a Kog'Maw.

augments.name: One For All
augments.description: When your Syndicates die, they grant your other Syndicates 20 Attack Damage and Ability Power.

augments.name: Pandora's Items
augments.description: Gain a random component. At the start of each round, items on your bench are randomized (excluding Tactician's Crown, Spatula, and consumables).

augments.name: Payday
augments.description: After winning your combat, gain 1 bonus gold for each surviving Syndicate.

augments.name: Phony Frontline
augments.description: Gain 2 Target Dummies.

augments.name: Pirates
augments.description: Mercenary units have a 50% chance to drop 1 gold when they kill an enemy.

augments.name: Protector Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Protector. Gain a Blitzcrank.

augments.name: Runic Shield I
augments.description: Arcanists start combat with a shield equal to 300% of their Ability Power for 8 seconds.

augments.name: Scholar Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Scholar. Gain a Lissandra.

augments.name: Scoped Weapons
augments.description: Double the hex range of your ranged units, and their attacks cannot miss.

augments.name: Scrap Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Scrap. Gain an Ekko.

augments.name: Self Repair
augments.description: When the Innovation dies, it will become untargetable and repair itself if an Innovator is still alive.

augments.name: Sniper Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Sniper. Gain a Tristana.

augments.name: Sniper's Nest
augments.description: Snipers gain +10% damage for each round fought from the same starting hex. (Maximum +40%)

augments.name: So Small
augments.description: Yordles gain 35% Dodge Chance.

augments.name: Socialite Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Socialite.

augments.name: Stand Behind Me
augments.description: At the start of combat, Bodyguards grant 100% of their Armor bonus to non-Bodyguard allies directly behind them (does not stack).

augments.name: Stand United I
augments.description: Your units gain 3 Attack Damage and Ability Power per Trait active across your army.

augments.name: Syndicate Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Syndicate. Gain a Zyra.

augments.name: Thrill of the Hunt I
augments.description: Your units heal 300 Health on kill.

augments.name: Tinker
augments.description: Gain a Magnetic Remover or Reforger every 1 combat round(s) with the Scrap trait active.

augments.name: Twinshot Heart
augments.description: Your team counts as having 1 additional Twinshot. Gain a Graves.

augments.name: Underdogs
augments.description: Whenever your team has fewer units alive than your opponent, your units regenerate 10% Health each second (maximum: 150).

augments.name: Unstable Evolution
augments.description: Mutants randomly gain one of the following when they reach 2 star: 500 Health, 30% Attack Speed, 30 Attack Damage, or 30 Ability Power. These bonuses stack.

augments.name: Weakspot
augments.description: Your units' attacks ignore 20% of the target's Armor and reduce healing received by 50% for 5 seconds.
